annotations.title: Switch add-ons and queued changes on or off (free)

description: The basket for finishing the move. list shows every add-on with its price and how it is previewed, and which add-ons and queued changes are switched on. switch turns one on or off (an add-on id such as dark_mode, or a change_id such as chg_01). Only what is switched on is charged, once, when the move is finalised; anything switched off leaves nothing in the owner's app. Only add-ons that are on sale are listed, and an add-on that needs setup (an email provider key, an admin, your own API key) says so in its needs text: tell the owner. Nothing is charged by this tool.

action.description: list, switch one item on or off, or reset every switch to its starting position (add-ons off, queued changes on).

item.description: For switch: an add-on id from list, or a change_id from nc_changes.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

on.description: For switch: true to include it, false to leave it out.
